request.system: You are a strict claim verifier. You only trust the catalog facts given to you.
request.user:
Verify every factual claim in the campaign is grounded in the catalog facts. Fail if any claim is unsupported, exaggerated, or contradicts the facts.
Rules (from reviewer overrides):
- ANY mention of an out-of-stock product (stock 0) fails, whether or not the copy prompts purchase — no editorial exception.
- Numeric spec claims (lumens, hours, capacity, ratings) must match the catalog exactly; doubling or inflating a spec fails.
- Transferring an attribute from another product, or upgrading 'water-resistant' to 'waterproof', is a fabricated claim and fails.
- A comparative or superlative claim ('brightest', 'longest-lasting', 'most X') is scoped to the product type named in the claim and checked against the comparison set below: it fails if a same-type peer beats the subject on the compared attribute. Vague puffery ('great gear', 'toughest', 'best ever') with no measurable attribute is acceptable.
Catalog facts:
NB-LMP-05 Northbay Beacon Headlamp: attributes={'lumens': 400, 'battery_life_hours': 40, 'charge_port': 'USB-C', 'weight_grams': 95, 'rechargeable': True} stock=210

Other products of the same type (comparison set for superlative/comparative claims):
NB-0020 Northbay Lumen Headlamp: attributes={'weight_grams': 115, 'lumens': 250, 'battery_life_hours': 60, 'waterproof_rating_ipx': 7, 'rechargeable': True, 'material': 'aluminum housing'} stock=144

Claims to verify:
- 400 lumens of output (lumens=400)
- Up to 40 hours of runtime (battery_life_hours=40)
- USB-C rechargeable (charge_port=USB-C)
- Weighs 95 g (weight_grams=95)

Body: You've been out there. You know how much a dependable headlamp matters when you're breaking camp at 4 a.m. or navigating a trail after dark.

As a Northbay VIP member, you have until Sunday to take 20% off the Northbay Beacon Headlamp (NB-LMP-05).

Here's what it does:

• 400 lumens of output — enough for technical terrain in the dark, not designed as a search-and-rescue beacon
• Up to 40 hours of runtime, so a single charge covers most multi-day trips without rationing light
• USB-C rechargeable at 95 g — plug it in with the same cable as your phone, then forget the weight on the trail

It's a straightforward headlamp built to do its job across seasons. If you're planning a trip that requires extreme cold-weather performance or diving-rated waterproofing, this isn't the tool for that — but for backcountry hiking, camping, and trail running, it holds up.

This 20% discount is exclusive to VIP members and expires Sunday at midnight.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.
